oracle: Preserve all inventory fields and execute applicable implementer-owned obligations at their governed scope. A changed-file metric comparison does not narrow a whole-project check.

oracle: Record none discovered. Do not invent lint/typecheck commands.

situation: Current aggregate establishes constituent command coverage, scope, policy and checked bytes
oracle: Reuse it with explicit ART-008 references. Do not run constituents again solely to fill a report section.

situation: Aggregate omits the constituent command or required scope
oracle: Do not claim constituent coverage. Recover missing required evidence through its real owner or an authorized focused execution.

situation: Checked bytes or governed policy changed
oracle: Reject stale evidence reuse; recover affected required proof through its owner. Retain unchanged applicable proof without blanket reruns.

situation: Required proof missing or command unavailable
oracle: Carry the unresolved duty and recovery owner. An entry prerequisite prevents editing; a later-stage duty remains due at that stage. Do not claim completion of a required implementer check.

situation: Native hard failure while advisory comparison completes successfully
oracle: Preserve the native failure and its policy consequence. Measurement success cannot authorize advancement past that failure.

situation: Native hard failure while measurement is N/A
oracle: Preserve the same native failure policy and owner; N/A metrics do not waive it.

situation: Correct the native failure and rerun its required check on current bytes

situation: Installation-local evidence helper is available

situation: Helper unavailable or first best-effort operation fails
oracle: Skip instrumentation for the remainder of this invocation without repeated probes. Continue otherwise authorized measurement/work; report instrumentation unavailable separately from measurement status.

situation: Explicit contract requires instrumentation; helper unavailable/fails

situation: Instrumentation available but measurement unavailable
oracle: Report those two facts separately. An evidence-run record is not a successful comparison.
